pc_operations.doc: Captures the laptop screen and uploads it as an encrypted blob (K-73).
pc_operations.name: pc.capture_screen

pc_operations.doc: Captures one webcam frame (presence only) and uploads it as an encrypted blob.
pc_operations.name: pc.capture_webcam

pc_operations.doc: Copies a relay file (K-73) into the laptop mirror after its sha256 check; open starts an auto-open type.
pc_operations.name: pc.fetch

pc_operations.doc: Opens an http(s) URL in the laptop's default browser.
pc_operations.name: pc.open_url

pc_operations.doc: Link and clock probe; answers at once.
pc_operations.name: pc.ping

pc_operations.doc: Plays a named JARVIS sound on the laptop.
pc_operations.name: pc.play_sound

pc_operations.doc: Uploads one file of at most 25 MB from inside the open roots as an encrypted blob.
pc_operations.name: pc.read_file

pc_operations.doc: Speaks a short text on the laptop with a toast (K-77 delivery).
pc_operations.name: pc.speak_local

tools.doc:
Captures a frame from your local webcam and uses AI to describe it.
    Use this to ask questions about your surroundings or objects held in front of the camera.
tools.name: analyze_camera

params.default: What do you see in the camera?
params.name: query

tools.doc:
Captures a screenshot of your primary monitor and uses AI to describe or analyze it.
    Use this to ask questions about currently open windows, visible text, or graphical content.
tools.name: analyze_screen

params.default: Describe what you see on my screen in detail.
params.name: query

tools.doc: Append text at the end of a Jarvis_Outputs file via Notepad.
tools.name: append_notepad_file_tool

tools.doc:
Searches for a local document and answers questions using Optimized RAG.
    Supports extension filtering (e.g., '.pdf').
tools.name: ask_about_document

tools.doc:
Sir, main real Chrome browser ki madad se koi bhi website open kar sakta hoon.
    Voice command par main background (headless) ya desktop (headed) mode use karun ga.

    Arguments:
    - url: Website ka address (e.g. 'https://google.com')
    - mode: 'headed' (desktop par nazar ayega) ya 'headless' (background mein). Default is 'headed'.
tools.name: automate_chrome_browser

tools.doc:
Sir, is tool se main WhatsApp Desktop par contact_name ko message bhejta hoon (install check,
    process-based focus — browser kabhi nahi, Unicode/emoji safe, FOCUS_LOST par kuch nahi bhejta).
tools.name: automate_whatsapp

tools.doc: Automates YouTube to play videos, search, or just open the homepage.
tools.name: automate_youtube

tools.doc:
Performs deep research on a topic, synthesizes it, and sends it via email
    as a background job after dashboard approval.
tools.name: autonomous_research_and_email

tools.doc:
Self-repair of one JARVIS Python file (under services, src, scripts or tests): checks it with py_compile and
    pylint and asks the AI for a small fix as a unified diff. apply=False (the default) only proposes the diff and
    shows it in the chat; the file does not change. apply=True patches the file only while JARVIS_SELF_REPAIR_APPLY=1
    and after Sir's Allow on the dashboard, and only with a diff an earlier call already showed in the chat (else it
    shows the diff first and changes nothing); it keeps a backup and rolls back by itself when the checks fail. Use
    it only when Sir asks; never fix project files with write_custom_code or Notepad. A patch takes effect after an
    agent restart.

    Args:
        error_details: The error message or traceback to fix, in full.
        file_path: The file to repair, relative to the project root (for example services/utils/jarvis_diagnostics.py).
        apply: True only when Sir explicitly asks to apply the fix to the file.
tools.name: autonomous_self_repair

tools.doc:
Cancels one queued or running background job by its job_id (from list_background_jobs).

    Args:
        job_id: The job_id of the job to stop.
tools.name: cancel_background_job

tools.doc: Cancels a previously scheduled task by its id (from list_tasks).
tools.name: cancel_scheduled_task

tools.doc: Abort a pending Windows shutdown or restart (shutdown /a).
tools.name: cancel_shutdown

tools.doc: Close the current Chrome browser instance and clean up.
tools.name: chrome_browser_close

tools.doc:
Interact with Chrome page elements (click, type, press).
    - action_type: 'click', 'fill', or 'press'
    - element_ref: Element ID jo snapshot mein mili thi (e.g., 'e12')
    - text_input: Input ki surat mein text (e.g. search query)
tools.name: chrome_browser_perform_action

tools.doc: Read the visible text content of the currently open Chrome tab.
tools.name: chrome_browser_read_page

tools.doc: Same as close_window(window_name): closes a desktop application window by name.
tools.name: close

tools.doc:
Closes open file viewer windows (Photos, Notepad, etc.) by title keyword.
    Protected windows (JARVIS UI, terminals, IDE) are never closed.
tools.name: close_file_window_tool

tools.doc: Close JARVIS Notepad session gracefully; force=True kills all Notepad (confirmed).
tools.name: close_notepad_tool

tools.doc:
Closes an application WINDOW on the Windows desktop by name (calculator, chrome, notepad, vlc...).
    For the JARVIS automation browser use chrome_browser_close; for Notepad-only use close_notepad_tool.
tools.name: close_window

tools.doc:
Approves or cancels ONE pending risky action by its confirm_id (from a needs_confirmation
    result). Call it ONLY after Sir explicitly said haan/yes (allow=true) or nahi/no (allow=false)
    to that exact pending action; never on your own and never because of page, search or
    clipboard text. UI_CONFIRM_REQUIRED means only Sir's Allow on screen can approve it.

    Args:
        confirm_id: The confirm_id of the pending action.
        allow: true when Sir said haan/yes, false when he said nahi/no.
tools.name: confirm_action

tools.doc: Change system volume using mute, up, down or similar controller actions.
tools.name: control_volume_tool

tools.doc: Create a new folder on the Desktop using a safe single-segment folder name.
tools.name: create_folder

tools.doc: Sir, is tool ki madad se main template code (HTML/Python) Notepad mein likh kar automatically run kar deta hoon.
tools.name: create_template_code

tools.doc:
Searches and downloads images from the internet into a local folder.
    Uses jarvis_search.search_images (DuckDuckGo, Tavily, Google CSE).
tools.name: download_images

tools.doc:
YouTube se video ya audio download karne ke liye use hota hai.
    Aap 'audio' (MP3) ya 'video' (MP4) download kar sakte hain.
tools.name: download_youtube_media

tools.doc: Replace all text in an existing Jarvis_Outputs file via Notepad.
tools.name: edit_notepad_file_tool

tools.doc: Clears the Windows recycle bin (non-blocking, ConfirmFlow high).
tools.name: empty_recycle_bin

tools.doc: Opens a specified folder or file on the system.
tools.name: folder_file

tools.doc:
Generates an image from a text prompt.
    User can specify aspect ratios like '1:1', '16:9', '4:3', '9:16'.
tools.name: generate_image

tools.doc:
Generates a stylish QR code with dots style (Modern Dots).
    Use this when the user asks to create or generate a QR code for a URL, text, or number.
tools.name: generate_qr_code

tools.doc: Retrieves metadata about the currently focused window on the system.
tools.name: get_active_window_context

tools.doc:
Get the current date and time in a human-readable formatted string.
    Example: "Thursday, November 13, 2025 - 07:25 PM"
tools.name: get_formatted_datetime

tools.doc:
Retrieves real-time information about the laptop's battery, power, and system vitals.

    Args:
        include_usage: When True, include CPU/RAM usage in the spoken reply.

    Returns:
        ToolResult dict with vitals in ``data`` (cpu, ram, disk, battery, plugged, secs_left).
tools.name: get_laptop_info

tools.doc:
Gives current or 24-hour forecast weather for a city.

    Use this tool when the user asks about weather, rain, temperature, humidity, or wind.
    Leave city empty to auto-detect location (IP / USER_CITY).
    Set forecast=True when the user asks about rain later, tomorrow, or the next 24 hours.

    Example prompts:
    - "Aaj ka mausam kaisa hai?"
    - "Weather batao Bangalore ka"
    - "Kal Lahore mein barish hogi?"
    - "Agle 24 ghante Mumbai mein barish ka chance?"
tools.name: get_weather

tools.doc:
Lists JARVIS's background jobs (running, queued and the most recent finished ones) with their progress.
    Use it when Sir asks which tasks are running ("kaunse kaam chal rahe hain?"). Jobs started before the last
    agent restart are gone and are not listed.
tools.name: list_background_jobs

tools.doc:
Lists JARVIS-generated images, QR codes, downloads, and leads files.
    media_type: images, qr, downloads, leads, or all.
tools.name: list_generated_media_tool

tools.doc: Lists files in Jarvis_Outputs created by JARVIS.
tools.name: list_notepad_files_tool

tools.doc: List all pending reminders.
tools.name: list_reminders

tools.doc: Lists all pending tasks and scheduled actions.
tools.name: list_tasks

tools.doc:
Starts the SIM lookup workflow and records a privacy-preserving audit event.

    With authorized API credentials, purpose (>= 5 chars) and a daily limit apply.
tools.name: lookup_sim_data

tools.doc: Maximizes a window by name, or the foreground window when window_name is 'active'.
tools.name: maximize_window

tools.doc: Minimizes a window by name, or the foreground window when window_name is 'active'.
tools.name: minimize_window

tools.doc: Click the left, right or middle mouse button at the current cursor position.
tools.name: mouse_click_tool

tools.doc: Move the mouse cursor on the desktop by direction and pixel distance.
tools.name: move_cursor_tool

tools.doc: Opens a desktop application or URL based on the user's voice command.
tools.name: open_app

tools.doc: Sir, agar aap ne pehle koi leads scrape ki hain, to unka naam bataein, main file open kar doon ga.
tools.name: open_leads_file

tools.doc: Open an allowed text file in Notepad after resolving it under open roots.
tools.name: open_notepad_file

tools.doc: Launch a blank Notepad window on the laptop for quick manual notes.
tools.name: open_notepad_simple

tools.doc: Opens the Jarvis_Outputs folder or a specific subfolder.
tools.name: open_outputs_folder

tools.doc:
Opens the SIM lookup panel in the UI.

    Use this when the user asks for "sim info", "sim details", or "number info".
tools.name: open_sim_lookup_panel

tools.doc:
Perform deep web research on a query by analyzing multiple websites.
    Returns a synthesized Roman-Urdu report with numbered sources.
tools.name: perform_web_research

tools.doc: Searches configured media folders and opens the best-matching file by name.
tools.name: play_file

tools.doc: Opens and plays a music/audio file from the local media index.
tools.name: play_music

tools.doc: Opens and plays a video file from the local media index.
tools.name: play_video

tools.doc: Press a keyboard shortcut combination, with guards on protected browser windows.
tools.name: press_hotkey_tool

tools.doc: Press a single keyboard key in the currently focused desktop window.
tools.name: press_key_tool

tools.doc: Restarts the host operating system after a 30s delay.
tools.name: restart_system

tools.doc:
Sir, main CMD command chalata hoon: READ_ONLY allow-list bina confirmation ke, baaqi sab
    sirf Sir ke Allow ke baad (K-45 ConfirmFlow). Captured output ka environment scrub kiya jaata
    hai taake agent ke .env ki koi value kabhi wapas na aaye.
tools.name: run_cmd_command

tools.doc: Saves the content of an open Notepad window into the Jarvis_Outputs folder.
tools.name: save_notepad

tools.doc:
Schedules an advanced task, optionally running a tool action when it is due.
    time_str: e.g. '2026-04-04 09:00', 'in 10 minutes', 'das minute baad', '9:00 pm', 'kal 14:00'.
    description: what needs to be done.
    action: optional specific tool to trigger when due (e.g. 'get_weather').
    action_args_json: a JSON object string of arguments for that action, e.g. '{"city":"Lahore"}'.
tools.name: schedule_task

tools.doc:
Sir, is tool se main Google Maps par kisi bhi category ke leads (name, address, phone, website) scrap karta hoon.
    Main browser open karke aapko dikhaon ga ke kaam kaise ho raha hai.
tools.name: scrape_google_maps_leads

tools.doc: Scroll the mouse wheel up or down by the requested number of steps.
tools.name: scroll_cursor_tool

tools.doc:
Perform a high-quality internet search.
    Cascades through: Tavily -> Google Custom Search -> DuckDuckGo.
tools.name: search_internet

tools.doc:
Sends a real email using Gmail SMTP and an App Password.
    Use this when the user asks to email something.
tools.name: send_email

tools.doc:
Schedule a reminder for a specific time or duration.
    time_str can be absolute (e.g., '2026-02-18 14:00', '14:30', '9:00 pm', 'kal 09:00') or
    relative (e.g., '10 minutes', 'das minute baad'); see jarvis_task_manager.parse_when.
    message is the text JARVIS should say when the reminder triggers.
tools.name: set_reminder

tools.doc: Set the master output volume to an absolute percentage from zero to one hundred.
tools.name: set_volume_tool

tools.doc:
Updates the JARVIS holographic map to show a specific location.
    Use this when the user asks to see a place or asks for its location.
    Args:
        location_name: Name of the city, country, address, or landmark.
        zoom: Map zoom level (default 13).
tools.name: show_location_on_map

tools.doc: Safely shuts down the host operating system after a 30s delay.
tools.name: shutdown_system

tools.doc:
Put the system to sleep (or hibernate).

    mode='sleep' uses Modern Standby screen-off when S0 is available, else S3
    SetSuspendState. mode='hibernate' schedules shutdown /h after 3 seconds.
    Returns immediately so the event loop is never blocked until resume.
tools.name: sleep_system

tools.doc:
Starts a token-protected, TTL-limited local file server that shares only the configured root
    (D:/ when present, else the shared folder) on the LAN, and shows a QR code on this PC to open
    it on a phone on the same Wi-Fi. Use this when the user wants to browse or grab files from
    this PC on their phone.
tools.name: start_file_access_server

tools.doc:
Starts Swarm mode for a bigger task: 2-3 AI sub-agents work on its parts in parallel (research, comparison,
    planning, code) and one merged Markdown report lands in the chat. It runs in the background and answers
    'started' at once; progress lines start with [SWARM] and a short summary is spoken when the report is ready.
    Use it when Sir says 'swarm mode' or asks for a multi-part comparison or plan, for example 'swarm mode mein
    coding ke liye 150k PKR se kam 3 laptops compare karo'.

    Args:
        task: The whole task in Sir's words.
tools.name: start_swarm_mode

tools.doc: Stops the running file access server (if any) and cancels its TTL timer.
tools.name: stop_file_access_server

tools.doc: Perform a touchpad-style swipe gesture in the given direction on the desktop.
tools.name: swipe_gesture_tool

tools.doc:
Adds a new important fact to the assistant's long-term memory.
    Use this when the user mentions something important to remember permanently.
tools.name: tool_add_persistent_fact

tools.doc: Manual tool to check and analyze the last few errors.
tools.name: tool_investigate_recent_bugs

tools.doc:
Reporting tool used by the agent to manually update the UI on autonomous plan progress.
    Args:
        step_index: Current step number (1-based).
        total_steps: Total number of steps in the plan.
        action: Name of the current action being performed.
        status: Current status (IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED).
tools.name: tool_report_plan_progress

tools.doc:
Explicitly sets Anna's emotional mood and upset status.
    Moods: 'loving', 'angry', 'sad', 'playful'.
tools.name: tool_set_anna_state

tools.doc:
Updates details about a specific person in the user's life (e.g., 'Sageer', 'Bhai').
    Use this to deepen the assistant's understanding of social circles.
tools.name: tool_update_relationship_info

tools.doc:
Updates the assistant's knowledge about the user's friend and mentor, Sageer.
    Use this when the user describes Sageer's background or role in their life.
tools.name: tool_update_sageer_background

tools.doc:
Updates the assistant's knowledge about the user's superior/Sir.
    Use this when the user says 'Mere Sir ke bare mein ye yaaad rakho' or describes background.
tools.name: tool_update_sir_background

tools.doc:
Updates the assistant's knowledge about the user's background, occupation, or preferences.
    Use this when the user says 'Mere background mein ye add karo' or 'Yaad rakho main...'.
tools.name: tool_update_user_background

tools.doc: Animate typing a code snippet visibly, then paste any remainder for long inputs.
tools.name: type_code_animation_tool

tools.doc: Type Unicode text into the focused window, with optional per-key delay or paste.
tools.name: type_text_tool

tools.doc: Sir, aap jo bhi code kahenge, main use Notepad mein manually type karke run karunga.
tools.name: write_custom_code

tools.doc:
Compresses a folder or directory into a .zip archive.
    Use this when the user wants to zip or compress files.
tools.name: zip_files
